messages.content: What is the capital of France?
The capital of France is Paris.
Name one benefit of regular exercise.
Regular exercise can improve cardiovascular health.
Write a short greeting for a new teammate.
Welcome to the team! We are glad to have you here.
CPU stands for central processing unit.
Give one reason plants need sunlight.
Plants use sunlight to produce energy through photosynthesis.
What is the opposite of hot?
The opposite of hot is cold.
